avisos.intro: Choose how you want to find out when a customer writes: with sound, with a desktop alert, or silently.
avisos.apagados: Alerts are off. You won't hear about new messages.
avisos.activos: We'll let you know when a customer writes.
avisos.principalDetalle: This is the main switch. Turn it off and nothing sounds and no alert appears.
avisos.enAppDetalle: The card that appears at the top right with the name and a preview of the message. Tap it to open the conversation.
avisos.sonidoDetalle: Plays a short tone when a message arrives.
avisos.escritorioDetalle: Your system's notification, for when you're in ANOTHER tab or app. If you're looking at Demandu, you'll see the card above instead of this one.
avisos.escritorioBloqueado: Your browser is blocking notifications for this site. Find it in the padlock in the address bar and allow them so you can turn this on.
avisos.escritorioNoSoportado: This browser doesn't support desktop alerts.
avisos.contadorDetalle: Shows how many unread messages you have in the browser tab title.
avisos.soloMiasDetalle: Only alert when someone writes in a chat assigned to someone on your team, not in ones that don't have an owner yet.
avisos.horarioSilencioDetalle: Don't alert within this range, every day.
avisos.funcionaDetalle: Fire a test alert with your current settings, exactly as you'd see it when a real message arrives.
avisos.pruebaCuerpo: This is how an alert looks when a customer writes to you. 👋
avisos.apagadosAviso: Alerts are off: turn them on above to actually receive them.
avisos.sonDeEstaComputadora: These preferences belong to this computer. Everyone on your team sets up their own, without affecting the others.

aparienciaChat.intro: Pick the color of the bubbles for messages you send. It only changes how your team sees them in Conversations — the customer still sees their normal WhatsApp.

gruposLeads.vacio: You don't have any lead groups yet. Create the first one above 👆

reservas.dibujaSalonDefineTus: Lay out your dining room and set your seatings. That way your assistant knows how many people fit at each table, which ones can be joined and when — and never takes a booking that doesn't fit.
reservas.noSePudoLeer: We couldn't load your dining room.

reservasMapa.aparecenAcomodadasEspacioLibre: They appear in the free space. Drag them wherever they belong.
reservasMapa.diCuantasMesasTienes: Enter how many tables you have above and they'll appear on their own.
reservasMapa.arrastraMesasColocarlasComo: Drag the tables to match your real dining room. It saves as soon as you drop them.
reservasMapa.pulsaMesaPlanoCambiar: Tap a table on the layout to change its name, how many people fit, and which ones it can be joined with.
reservasMapa.marcaSoloVerdadCaben: Only tick the ones that really fit together in your room. Lana will join these and no others.

reservasTurnos.todaviaNoTienesMesas: You don't have any tables in the layout yet. A seating with no tables can't take bookings — lay out your dining room first.
reservasTurnos.todaviaNoTienesTurnos: You don't have any seatings yet. Create the first one on the right: for example “First seating”, 7:00 p.m.
reservasTurnos.sinNingunDiaMarcado: With no day ticked, this seating would never take a booking.
reservasTurnos.dejaloApagadoTusHoras: Leave it off during your busiest hours. In a full seating, one table too many means people standing at the door. With it off, Lana holds the table and checks with you first.
reservasTurnos.ahiArribaLanaNo: Above that, Lana doesn't decide: she lets you know so you can handle it.
reservasTurnos.cuantasComoMaximoMismo: The most you'd join for a single party. Joining too many means moving chairs and blocking an aisle.

enBloque.nadieEnEquipo: There's no one on your team yet.
enBloque.notaAsignarContactos: Their open conversations and their Pipeline card get assigned.
enBloque.ayudaEtiquetas: One click: add. Another: remove. Another: leave as is.

enBloque.cerrarDetalleTarjetas: Their Pipeline cards don't move. If the customer writes again, the conversation reopens on its own.
enBloque.noContesto: Couldn't finish. Check your connection and try again.
